title: Ezra hero
description: A centred cream hero: a light 88px display-serif headline whose last words turn terracotta italic, a short 18px line, one terracotta pill, then a white hairline notice card (co-brand lockup, two lines, outline pill) and a tall portrait cut-out anchored to the bottom edge. A terracotta wash opens down over the cut-out as the page scrolls.
notes: content-sized, not window-sized, as the original: the cut-out sits under the first screen
the cut-out is a media slot (portrait, aspect 366/662); the scrubbed wash stands in for the original's rings drawing in around it
scroll wash is CSS scroll-driven, off without support or under reduced motion
